model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (shape Request (sketch "A request."))
  (shape Event (sketch "A event."))
  (shape Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (shape Command (sketch "A command."))
  (shape Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block RetryRouter
      (takes Snapshot)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
    (block EdgeRenderer
      (takes Request :as req)
      (gives Request :as done)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
      (level
        (block LiveMetrics
          (takes Snapshot :as evt)
          (gives Snapshot)
          (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block Metrics
                (takes Receipt :as evt)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Index
                (takes Command)
                (gives Request)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (block RemoteSync
                (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
            (adjacent
              (block ShadowCatalog :type "Service"
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block RemoteParser
                (gives Request :as emit)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
              (block Mailer :type "Feature"
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (block Router
                (gives Receipt :as done)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
            (block BatchAuth
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block RemotePricing
                (gives Event :as emit)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Scheduler :type "Process"
                (takes Snapshot)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Editor
                (takes Receipt)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (block RemoteSession
                (gives Request)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))
        (block EdgeCache
          (takes Command :as evt)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block LocalMailer
                (takes Snapshot :as req)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Audit :type "Store"
                (takes Event)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block RetryPlanner
                (gives Snapshot :as done)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))))
        (block Session
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
          (level
            (block EdgeSync
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block EdgeIndex
              (takes Command :as req)
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))))
    (block EdgeLedger
      (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
  (level
    (block ShadowCache :type "Store"
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
    (block LocalIndex :type "Service"
      (gives Event :as emit)
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
    (block EdgeScheduler :type "Service"
      (gives Receipt :as done)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
    (block LiveFeed
      (takes Receipt :as req)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))))
